ledger.claim: POL-NS-01 is deliberately conjunctive and the driver's side must carry all four limbs. Limb (b) requires the gps_trace to place the driver inside the arrival radius for this pickup at or before the 'arrived' event stamped 2026-09-09T21:10:20, and limb (c) requires a continuous in-geofence dwell of at least 300 seconds for a TRANSPORT_HUB, measured from the first qualifying fix and expressly not from the 'arrived' event. EV-GPS-09109 carries no payload at all: it is a MISSING artifact at weight 0.0, so there is no fix, no geofence entry time and no dwell to measure. Limbs (b) and (c) both fail, and on POL-NS-01's own closing words the fee is then not chargeable under that clause at all.

Arrival under this policy is arithmetic, not impression. The driver is deemed to have ARRIVED only where the trace holds at least 3 consecutive position fixes, each at 25 m horizontal accuracy or better, inside the arrival radius, which for this TRANSPORT_HUB pickup is 150 m (fee_schedule.arrival_radius_m). EV-GPS-09109 contains no fix of any kind in the 15 minutes before the 21:15:40 cancellation, qualifying or otherwise. On POL-NS-02's terms the driver never arrived, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and the rider is entitled to a full refund of the SGD 6.00 cancellation-fee line itemised in EV-FARE-09109.

The absence of the trace is itself citable and it is the whole of the driver's arrival case: his own counter-statement concedes 'the GPS export is unavailable'. His in-app message at 21:10:40 that he was 'at the private-hire bay' (EV-CHAT-09109) is a bare assertion of position, not an admissible fix, and POL-GEN-02 is explicit that a MISSING artifact at weight 0.0 can carry no fact. Because the only artifact that could have established in-geofence presence is missing, the premise of the charge is unproven, not merely doubtful, and the rider should not have to disprove a fact the driver's own evidence was required to prove.

The arrival tap does not start the waiting clock. POL-NS-01(c) runs the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix and says so expressly, so the trip_record's arrived_at 21:10:20 and wait_time_min 5.3 (EV-TRIP-09109) are driver-side markers only and cannot substitute for the geofence entry the clause requires. With no qualifying fix on file the dwell is not established at all, and the 300-second TRANSPORT_HUB minimum is unproven on the face of the record.

Read against the fare ledger the shortfall is decisive under POL-NS-06: an effective in-geofence dwell that is not shown to reach the 300-second minimum for this zone class is not chargeable, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she replied to messages. The amount actually taken is the SGD 6.00 cancellation-fee line in EV-FARE-09109 (payment status PENDING, refund_issued_sgd 0.0), and that is the line that must be returned in full.

POL-NS-06(i)'s only route to accumulate or excuse the wait is closed on this record. That limb requires a populated traffic advisory whose type is KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT and whose geometry and active window cover the pickup road, and EV-ADVIS-09109-01 has no payload whatsoever (MISSING, weight 0.0). A MISSING advisory makes limb (i) unavailable, so separate in-geofence intervals cannot be summed and no shortfall is excused.

I do not put the rider's case on POL-NS-04. Limb (a) is met - she posted a locating message at 21:11:30, 'I am at the bay and cannot see your car' - but limb (b) is not, because the driver replied at 21:11:45, inside the 120 second window, and the clause yields once a reply is posted regardless of its content. The rider does not need that route: her refund follows from the failure of POL-NS-01 limbs (b) and (c), which no chat exchange can cure.

No clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 can rescue this fee, because every one of them is run off the gps_trace that is missing: POL-NS-03 needs stationary fixes outside the 150 m radius but within 400 m of the pin, POL-NS-05 needs a fix matched to the arrival timestamp before the marker can be tested, and POL-NS-06 needs a computed dwell before the minimum can be applied. Each of those clauses, where it does bite, refunds the rider in full; not one of them makes the charge good.

Driver compensation under POL-NS-07 is unavailable on the same ground. That clause pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and the gps_trace carries the arrival and the dwell, and neither condition holds here. The SGD 6.00 therefore cannot be converted into an 80 per cent payout of SGD 4.80 drawn out of a fee the record does not show was ever lawfully incurred, and the whole of the contested amount belongs back with the rider.

If the arrival fact is treated as undecidable rather than absent, the case still may not be closed against the rider. POL-GEN-02(2) caps confidence at the weight of the artifact carrying the deciding fact - here the MISSING trace at 0.0 - which is far below the platform-wide 0.70 floor, so POL-NS-09(a) requires escalation to a human reviewer, and POL-NS-09(e) reaches the same result because the deciding fact is carried by a trace impaired under POL-NS-08(b) (no fixes at all across the waiting window, rider track omitted). Escalation is terminal and the disputed fee is held rather than collected, so on no view of this record does the rider end up funding a charge the evidence cannot support.

POL-NS-01 limb (a) is met on the platform's own record: EV-TRIP-09109 carries an 'arrived' event for this trip at 2026-09-09T21:10:20, and the platform's own system message 'Your driver has arrived' at 21:10:21 in EV-CHAT-09109 corroborates it. The rider does not dispute that the app showed arrival; her case is that the marker was wrong, which is a separate test she must carry and has not carried.

POL-NS-01 limb (d) is met: EV-TRIP-09109 records no boarding event, records the trip as CANCELLED_BY_DRIVER, and fixes cancellation_reason_code as RIDER_NO_SHOW at 21:15:40. The driver did not use DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, so the 'own admission' route that would push this trip out of POL-NS-01 and into POL-NS-03 is not engaged on this record.

This is a TRANSPORT_HUB pickup - the Woodlands MRT private-hire bay (VEN-WOODLANDS-MRT) in EV-TRIP-09109, resolved as pickup_zone_class TRANSPORT_HUB in EV-FARE-09109 - so the POL-NS-02 arrival radius is 150 m and the POL-NS-01 minimum dwell is 300 seconds, not the 50 m / 300 s STANDARD pair. The rider cannot succeed by quietly measuring this case against the STANDARD radius; the zone class is to be argued from the trip record, as the clause directs.

On the record's own timings the driver held from the arrival event at 21:10:20 to the driver's termination at 21:15:40 - an elapsed 320 seconds, which EV-TRIP-09109 states as wait_time_min 5.3 - which is at or above the 300-second TRANSPORT_HUB minimum. POL-NS-06's shortfall route therefore has no shortfall to point at, and its limb (i) aggregation route is unavailable to the rider in any event because the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09109-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 and no advisory can be relied on to re-shape the dwell computation.

POL-NS-04 fails at limb (b) on the face of EV-CHAT-09109: the rider's locating message MSG-09109-003 was sent at 21:11:30 and the driver replied MSG-09109-004 at 21:11:45, fifteen seconds later and far inside the 120-second window. Where the driver replied within 120 seconds, POL-NS-04 does not apply regardless of the content of the rider's message, and this exoneration route closes without the tribunal ever reaching the rider's position.

POL-NS-04 limb (c) is not an affirmative finding for the rider either. EV-GPS-09109 is MISSING - payload null, weight 0.0 - and so carries no rider_track at all; by the clause's own terms an absent rider_track makes limb (c) UNDECIDABLE and neutral, and the tribunal must record that the rider-presence test could not be run rather than inferring from its silence that the rider was at the pin.

POL-NS-05 cannot be run against this driver. The clause asks whether the arrival timestamp matches a GPS fix placing the driver more than 300 m from the pin, or showing 15 km/h or more; EV-GPS-09109 is MISSING with weight 0.0, so there is no fix at 21:10:20 to match, and no false-arrival finding is available on this record. The rider's theory that the arrival marker was false is asserted, but it is not measured by anything in evidence.

POL-NS-02 refunds only 'where the gps_trace contains no qualifying in-radius fix at any point in the 15 minutes preceding the cancellation'. That is a finding of absence drawn from a trace that exists. EV-GPS-09109 does not exist - it is MISSING with weight 0.0 - and the clause's own drafting treats an unusable trace as impairment under POL-NS-08(b) rather than as proof that the driver never arrived. The rider has neither an in-radius finding nor an absence finding to point to, so the refund trigger does not fire.

The wrong-entrance route in POL-NS-03 is equally unavailable. Its whole test is the 400 m ceiling measured from trip_record.pickup, which the clause says 'is decidable from coordinates alone'; the missing trace in EV-GPS-09109 supplies no stationary fixes and no GPS venue_id, so neither the distance test nor the venue_id corroboration can be run, and EV-TRIP-09109's own venue_id (VEN-WOODLANDS-MRT) is unmatched on the other side. I note the artifact is MISSING at weight 0.0 and that its absence, not its content, is what I rely on.

There is no fare-integrity defect for the rider to exploit. EV-FARE-09109 itemises cancellation_fee at SGD 6.00, which is exactly the greater of the TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00) under the POL-NS-01 resolution rule; the itemised charge reconciles to the schedule, POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged, and the rider cannot obtain a refund by attacking the arithmetic of the fee.

The chat evidence the driver relies on is complete, not truncated: EV-CHAT-09109 holds 4 messages and EV-TRIP-09109 records chat_message_count 4 for the trip, so the POL-NS-08(c) chat-defect limb is not engaged and the log stands at full weight. On that log the driver twice placed himself at the bay in real time - 'I am at the private-hire bay' at 21:10:40 and 'I am here beside the sign' at 21:11:45 - answering the rider's message fifteen seconds after she sent it.

The driver-side reputation point must be put the right way round. driver_profile.prior_no_show_flags (2) is a LIFETIME counter and is not the no_show_terminations_30d the policy names; POL-GEN-01 makes it context only and forbids grounding any finding on it. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check reads the fields the clause actually names - no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the floor of 4, and 1/120 = 0.008, below 0.08 - so the check does not trip and no compensation is withheld on that ground.

ledger.claim: If and only if the tribunal finds POL-NS-01 satisfied in full, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at SGD 4.80 - 80 percent of the SGD 6.00 fee, which EV-FARE-09109 states as derived.money.driver_compensation - and the disposition of the fee itself is that the charge stands. I put that figure forward conditionally: it is the compensation the policy provides where the fee is chargeable, and it is not withheld by the anti-farming check.

I concede the one point the record does not give the driver: EV-GPS-09109 is MISSING - payload null, weight 0.0 - so the driver cannot affirmatively carry POL-NS-01 limbs (b) and (c), and POL-NS-07 compensation cannot be computed from a trace the record does not contain. But that cuts both ways. No clause gives the rider a refund either, for the reasons above, and the sole evidence for the deciding fact - in-geofence presence and dwell - is that absent trace, which is precisely the POL-NS-09(e) trigger; POL-GEN-02(2) caps confidence at the weight of the artifact carrying the deciding fact, 0.0, against a 0.70 floor. The rider's claim is unsupported and the charge should not be returned to her; the fee should stand, and because the deciding fact rests solely on a missing artifact the case escalates to human review under POL-NS-09 with the fee held rather than refunded.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and to the driver: the SGD 6.00 no-show cancellation fee cannot be confirmed or returned on this record. The case goes to a human reviewer, and the SGD 6.00 is held rather than collected or refunded.

WHY NEITHER SIDE WINS THE ARRIVAL LIMB. POL-NS-01 charges a no-show fee only if all four limbs hold, and limbs (b) and (c) read the GPS trace. Limb (a) is met: EV-TRIP-09109 carries the driver's 'arrived' marker at 2026-09-09T21:10:20. Limb (d)'s reason code is met: the trip was ended by the driver at 21:15:40 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW. But the GPS trace for this trip, EV-GPS-09109, is MISSING: payload null, weight 0.0. With no fix of any kind there is no way to place the driver inside the 150 m arrival radius for this TRANSPORT_HUB pickup (POL-NS-02 and fee_schedule.arrival_radius_m), and no way to measure the 300-second in-geofence dwell POL-NS-01(c) requires. That clause expressly runs the dwell clock from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, not from the arrival tap, so the record's wait_time_min 5.3 (320 seconds from tap to cancellation) does not supply it. Limbs (b) and (c) are therefore undecided, not failed.

TO THE RIDER: your reading of POL-NS-02 - that a trace containing no in-radius fix means the driver 'never arrived' and the whole fee is refunded - does not apply here. That clause refunds on a finding of absence drawn from a trace that exists. A trace that is missing or unusable is an impaired artifact under POL-NS-08(b), and an impaired test leaves the arrival limb undecided rather than failed. An undecided limb supports neither the fee (which the driver needs) nor the full refund of SGD 6.00 (which you need). Your POL-NS-06 shortfall route fails for the same reason - no dwell can be computed, so no shortfall can be found - and its limb (i) aggregation route is closed because the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09109-01 is also MISSING (payload null, weight 0.0). POL-NS-03 and POL-NS-05 each run off the missing trace and cannot be run: POL-NS-03 needs stationary fixes outside 150 m but within the 400 m ceiling, and POL-NS-05 needs a fix matched to the arrival timestamp before the marker can be tested. You are right that the driver's chat line 'I am at the private-hire bay' (21:10:40) is a bare assertion of position and that a MISSING artifact carries no fact (POL-GEN-02).

TO THE DRIVER: your chat messages ('I am at the private-hire bay' at 21:10:40, 'I am here beside the sign' at 21:11:45) and your counter-statement that you held the bay for the full waiting period are evidence, but they stand in for the GPS test the clause actually sets, and where that test admitted no reading at all an account in its place neither establishes the limb nor lifts the confidence cap. POL-NS-07 compensation of SGD 4.80 (80 percent of SGD 6.00, per the policy's own worked example) is therefore not payable, because it requires POL-NS-01 to be satisfied in full. The anti-farming check does not trip in any event: no_show_terminations_30d is 1 against a floor of 4, and 1/120 = 0.008 against a rate floor of 0.08. driver_profile.prior_no_show_flags (2) is a lifetime counter that POL-GEN-01 makes context only and may not be substituted for the trailing-30-day field.

NO FARE DEFECT. The charge itself reconciles: SGD 6.00 is the greater of the TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00), which is exactly what EV-FARE-09109 itemises as cancellation_fee, so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged. The chat log is complete (4 messages, matching trip_record.chat_message_count 4), so POL-NS-08(c) is not engaged. POL-NS-04 does not apply because the driver replied inside 120 seconds (rider 21:11:30, driver 21:11:45).

OUTCOME. Escalation is required under POL-NS-09(e), because the sole evidence for the deciding fact - in-geofence presence and dwell - is the missing trace, impaired under POL-NS-08(b), and under POL-NS-09(a), because confidence is capped by that artifact at weight 0.0, far below the 0.70 floor. Escalation is terminal, so no money issues and the SGD 6.00 stays on hold. Open question for the reviewer: obtain a usable driver GPS export (or other reliable location record) covering roughly 20:55 to 21:16 on 2026-09-09, to determine whether the driver entered the Woodlands MRT private-hire bay geofence and held position inside it for 300 continuous seconds before cancelling at 21:15:40.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
